title: Blackhawk Curling Club
specs: Three sheet curling facility located within Rock County Fairgrounds
Hosts multiple annual bonspiels including Women's First Chance, Mixed, Men's Last Chance, and Festivus Open
Members age 16+ may curl in the Open League; ages 12-15 may curl with parent, guardian, or sponsor and 3 years experience
No member under 18 may curl in Tuesday AM Pick up League; substitutes under 18 must be with a sponsor
No member under 16 may curl in Women's Leagues except ages 12-15 with parent, guardian, or sponsor
No member under 16 may curl in Men's Leagues except ages 12-15 with parent, guardian, or sponsor
No member under 18 may curl in Mixed Leagues; no substitutes under 15
Leagues consist of teams created by members or by draft depending on league
Teams can register as individuals, couples, or established teams depending on league

options.detail: Men only teams established by draft, two draws with weekly dinner

blurb: Members participate in men's, women's, mixed, open and doubles leagues from November through March. The club hosts several bonspiels annually including Women's First Chance, Mixed, Men's Last Chance, and Festivus Open. The facility has three sheets of ice located within the Rock County Fairgrounds.
